items.en: A sudden and unexpected event or shock.
items.hi: अचानक और अप्रत्याशित संकट या आघात

tr.ur: ناگہانی صدمہ یا غیر متوقع واقعہ

items.ex: The news of the company closing down came as a bolt from the blue for Rohit.

items.en: Something that happens very rarely.
items.hi: बहुत ही कम होने वाली घटना
items.ex: Priya visits her hometown only once in a blue moon due to her busy schedule.

items.en: Work or study late into the night.
items.bn: গভীর রাত পর্যন্ত কাজ বা পড়াশোনা করা
items.hi: देर रात तक पढ़ाई या काम करना

tr.ta: நள்ளிரவு வரை வேலை செய்வது அல்லது படிப்பது
tr.gu: મોડી રાત સુધી કામ કે અભ્યાસ કરવો
tr.ur: دیر رات تک محنت یا پڑھائی کرنا
tr.or: ରାତି ଅଧ ଯାଏ ପରିଶ୍ରମ କିମ୍ବା ପଢ଼ାପଢ଼ି କରିବା
tr.pa: ਦੇਰ ਰਾਤ ਤੱਕ ਪੜ੍ਹਾਈ ਜਾਂ ਕੰਮ ਕਰਨਾ

items.ex: Aarav is burning the midnight oil to crack the upcoming civil services exam.

items.en: At the last possible moment before a deadline.
items.ex: She submitted her project application at the eleventh hour just before the portal closed.

items.en: Make people feel more comfortable in a conversation.
items.bn: কথাবার্তা শুরু করে জড়তা দূর করা
items.hi: बातचीत शुरू करके हिचकिचाहट दूर करना

tr.gu: વાતચીત શરૂ કરીને સંકોચ દૂર કરવો
tr.ur: گفتگو کا آغاز کر کے جھجھک دور کرنا
tr.or: କଥାବାର୍ତ୍ତା ଆରମ୍ଭ କରି ଦ୍ବିଧା ଦୂର କରିବା

items.ex: The trainer played a quick game to break the ice among the new recruits.

items.en: Reveal secret information prematurely or accidentally.
items.ex: Rohan accidentally spilled the beans about the surprise anniversary party.

items.en: Avoid coming to the main point directly.
items.bn: মূল কথা এড়িয়ে ঘুরিয়ে কথা বলা
items.hi: मुख्य मुद्दे पर न आकर इधर-उधर की बातें करना

tr.mr: मूळ मुद्द्यावर न येता वळणावळणाने बोलणे
tr.ta: நேரடியாக விஷயத்திற்கு வராமல் சுற்றி வளைத்துப் பேசுதல்
tr.gu: મુખ્ય મુદ્દા પર ન આવતાં ગોળ-ગોળ વાતો કરવી
tr.ur: اصل بات کے بجائے ادھر ادھر کی باتیں کرنا
tr.kn: ನೇರ ವಿಷಯಕ್ಕೆ ಬಾರದೆ ಸುತ್ತಿ ಬಳಸಿ ಮಾತನಾಡುವುದು
tr.or: ମୂଳ କଥାକୁ ନ ଆସି ଘୁରାଇ-ଫେରାଇ କହିବା
tr.pa: ਅਸਲ ਗੱਲ 'ਤੇ ਆਉਣ ਦੀ ਬਜਾਏ ਗੱਲ ਘੁਮਾਉਣਾ
tr.as: মূল কথা নকৈ ফালৰি কাটি কথা কোৱা

items.ex: Instead of beating about the bush, tell me directly what you need.

items.en: Face a difficult situation with courage.
items.bn: কঠিন পরিস্থিতির সাহসের সাথে মুখোমুখি হওয়া
items.hi: कठिन परिस्थिति का साहसपूर्वक सामना करना

tr.ur: صبر و ہمت کے ساتھ مشکل کا سامنا کرنا
tr.or: ସାହସର ସହିତ କଠିନ ପରିସ୍ଥିତିର ସାମ୍ନା କରିବା
tr.pa: ਦਲੇਰੀ ਨਾਲ ਔਖੀ ਘੜੀ ਦਾ ਸਾਹਮਣਾ ਕਰਨਾ

items.ex: Neha decided to bite the bullet and talk to her manager about the salary.

items.en: Stop working on something for the rest of the day.

tr.ur: اس دن کا کام ختم کرنا
tr.or: ସେହି ଦିନ ପାଇଁ କାମ ବନ୍ଦ କରିବା

items.ex: After reviewing ten chapters, the study group decided to call it a day.

items.en: Something good that at first seemed bad.
items.bn: আপাতদৃষ্টিতে খারাপ কিন্তু বাস্তবে শুভ কিছু
items.hi: शुरुआत में बुरा दिखने वाला वरदान या लाभ

tr.mr: प्रारंभी वाईट वाटणारी पण शेवटी फायदेशीर ठरणारी गोष्ट
tr.gu: શરૂઆતમાં ખરાબ લાગે પણ પછીથી ફાયદાકારક નીવડે તેવી બાબત
tr.ur: ظاہری زحمت جو حقیقت میں رحمت ثابت ہو
tr.kn: ಆರಂಭದಲ್ಲಿ ಕೆಟ್ಟದ್ದಾಗಿ ಕಂಡರೂ ಆಮೇಲೆ ಒಳ್ಳೆಯದಾಗುವ ವಿಷಯ
tr.or: ପ୍ରଥମେ ଖରାପ ଜଣାପଡ଼ୁଥିବା କିନ୍ତୁ ପରେ ଶୁଭ ଫଳ ଦେଉଥିବା ଘଟଣା
tr.ml: ആദ്യ കാഴ്ചയിൽ മോശമെന്ന് തോന്നുമെങ്കിലും പിന്നീട് അനുഗ്രഹമാകുന്ന കാര്യം
tr.pa: ਸ਼ੁਰੂ ਵਿੱਚ ਮਾੜਾ ਲੱਗਣ ਵਾਲਾ ਪਰ ਬਾਅਦ ਵਿੱਚ ਫਾਇਦੇਮੰਦ ਸਾਬਤ ਹੋਣ ਵਾਲਾ
tr.as: প্ৰথমতে বেয়া যেন লাগিলেও পৰৱৰ্তী সময়ত আশীৰ্বাদ স্বৰূপ হোৱা ঘটনা

items.ex: Missing that bus was a blessing in disguise as it saved him from the traffic jam.

items.en: make a bad situation worse
items.ex: Rohan's angry remarks only added fuel to the fire during the meeting.

items.en: pursuing a wrong course of action or blaming the wrong person
items.ex: If you think I took your keys, you are barking up the wrong tree.

items.term: burn the candle at both ends
items.en: work extremely hard without getting enough rest
items.hi: दिन-रात एक करके कड़ी मेहनत करना

tr.or: ଦିନରାତି ଏକ କରି କଠିନ ପରିଶ୍ରମ କରିବା

items.ex: Priya burned the candle at both ends to clear her entrance exam.

items.en: end a quarrel and make peace

tr.or: ପୁରୁଣା ଶତ୍ରୁତା ଭୁଲି ଶାନ୍ତି ବଜାୟ ରଖିବା
tr.pa: ਪੁਰਾਣੀ ਦੁਸ਼ਮਣੀ ਭੁਲਾ ਕੇ ਸਮਝੌਤਾ ਕਰਨਾ

items.ex: After years of dispute, the two neighbors decided to bury the hatchet.

items.en: by any means necessary, fair or unfair
items.hi: किसी भी तरह से, चाहे सही हो या गलत
items.ex: He wanted to finish the project before deadline by hook or by crook.

items.en: accept the unpleasant consequences of one's actions
items.hi: अपने कर्मों के बुरे परिणाम भुगतना
items.ex: After breaking the window, Kabir had to face the music when his parents arrived.

items.en: ability to speak persuasively and eloquently
items.ex: Anita's gift of the gab helped her win the debate competition easily.

items.term: hit the nail on the head
items.en: describe exactly what is causing a situation
items.ex: During the discussion, Rahul hit the nail on the head regarding the cause of delay.

items.en: try everything possible to achieve something
items.ex: The police left no stone unturned to find the missing child.

items.en: under all circumstances, good and bad
items.ex: True friends stay together through thick and thin.

items.en: A very easy task
items.ex: For Riya, the reasoning section was a piece of cake.

items.en: Regret something that cannot be undone
items.bn: যা হয়ে গেছে তা নিয়ে আফসোস করা
items.ex: The exam is over, so don't cry over spilt milk; prepare for the next one.

items.en: Do something cheaply or carelessly to save time or money
items.bn: খরচ বা সময় বাঁচাতে কাজে ফাঁকি দেওয়া
items.hi: समय या पैसा बचाने के लिए लापरवाही से काम करना
items.ex: The builder cut corners, and the wall cracked within a year.

items.en: Become nervous and back out at the last moment
items.bn: শেষ মুহূর্তে ভয় পেয়ে পিছিয়ে যাওয়া
items.hi: ऐन वक्त पर घबराकर पीछे हटना
items.ex: Arjun got cold feet just before his first public speech.

items.en: Go to bed
items.ex: After a long shift, Meena hit the sack at nine.

items.en: In trouble
items.ex: The clerk landed in hot water for losing the files.

items.term: let the cat out of the bag
items.en: Reveal a secret by mistake
items.bn: ভুল করে গোপন কথা ফাঁস করা
items.ex: My brother let the cat out of the bag about the surprise trip.

items.en: Lose an opportunity by acting too late
items.ex: He missed the boat by applying a day after the deadline.

items.en: Extremely happy
items.ex: Priya was on cloud nine after clearing the PO interview.

items.en: After a bad experience, one becomes very careful
items.bn: ঘর পোড়া গরু সিঁদুরে মেঘ দেখলে ডরায়
items.hi: दूध का जला छाछ भी फूँक-फूँककर पीता है
items.ex: After losing money once, he never lends again: once bitten, twice shy.

items.en: Tease someone playfully
items.ex: Relax, I was only pulling your leg about the exam date.

items.en: Agree fully with someone
items.ex: The two partners rarely see eye to eye on expenses.

items.term: the ball is in your court
items.en: It is now your turn to decide or act
items.hi: अब फ़ैसला तुम्हारे हाथ में है
items.ex: We have made our offer; the ball is in your court now.

items.en: Slightly unwell
items.ex: Grandmother is feeling under the weather today.

items.en: A very small amount compared with what is needed
items.ex: The relief fund was a drop in the ocean for the flood victims.

items.en: Someone who is loved very much
items.ex: The youngest grandchild is the apple of her eye.

items.en: In strong disagreement
items.ex: The two neighbours have been at loggerheads over the boundary wall.

items.en: Take on a risky task for the group
items.hi: जोखिम भरा काम अपने सिर लेना
items.ex: Everyone wanted to complain to the boss, but no one would bell the cat.

items.en: Offer something valuable to people who cannot value it
items.ex: Explaining poetry to him is like casting pearls before swine.

items.en: An unbelievable made-up story
items.ex: The boy told a cock and bull story to explain his late arrival.

items.en: Pretended sorrow
items.ex: The cheat shed crocodile tears in front of the judge.

items.en: An achievement to be proud of
items.ex: Winning the state award was a feather in her cap.

items.en: Be logically sound
items.ex: His excuse does not hold water.

items.en: Just in time
items.ex: The ambulance arrived in the nick of time.

items.term: keep the wolf from the door
items.en: Earn just enough to avoid hunger
items.ex: He took two jobs to keep the wolf from the door.

items.en: Stop something at an early stage
items.hi: शुरुआत में ही खत्म कर देना
items.ex: The teacher nipped the rumour in the bud.

items.en: Be the one in control
items.ex: In this office, the senior clerk rules the roost.

items.en: Run away
items.ex: The thief took to his heels when the police came.

items.en: A costly possession that is of little use
items.ex: The unused stadium has become a white elephant for the town.

items.en: A very happy and memorable day
items.ex: Her first salary day was a red letter day for the family.
